name: interface_roundtrip_observation
purpose: Measure semantic round-trip fidelity between an emitted interface action description and what is observed back. Missing or extra semantics reduce fidelity; empty-to-empty yields zero rather than artificial certainty.
principles: round-trip evidence is observation rather than authority
missing and unexpected semantics both reduce fidelity
token order and duplicates do not change semantic fidelity
zero observed vocabulary yields zero confidence
